claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic Claude Code local-host route planner/validator for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes an explicit caller-supplied host capability report plus release/state-lineage identities and produces a typed install-route candidate mapping concrete Claude host surfaces onto the semantic lifecycle roles SESSION_START, USER_TURN, PRE_EFFECT, POST_EFFECT, SESSION_STOP, PRE_COMPACT_OR_CHECKPOINT, TOOL_RESULT_RETURN and optional BACKGROUND_WAKE. Required-role gaps fail closed to DEGRADED/BLOCKED; matching hook names alone never count as firing evidence; canonical durable state must remain outside disposable Claude plugin/cache roots; optional VPS/HCU attachment cannot be a prerequisite for baseline local boot. The component plans/validates only: no filesystem writes, hook installation, host probing, provider/model/tool calls, UnifiedDB mutation, effects, physical-host installer credit or whole-system completion. Source/tests plus repository-hosted CI only. F2-WP-1101 owns generic host capability discovery/ABI and is not modified by this claim.
